Hi — I'm Leticia from Talent Acquisition at NovaBio Therapeutics. We've just wrapped up the hiring process for our new Director of Clinical Operations and I need a formal offer letter generated for the candidate. All the details are scattered across some notes and files in the hr/recruiting/2025/Q2/ folder and a few supporting docs in finance/ and company/ — the intake draft, the finance approval email, the benefits summary, org chart info, etc.

Can you pull everything together and generate the complete, professional offer letter as a file named `offer_letter_marcus_webb.txt`? It needs to be ready to send — meaning fully filled out with all the compensation details, equity terms, benefits, contingencies, deadlines, and a proper signature section at the end. Make sure it reflects everything that was approved.
